searchText: question to builders and relays. What's the plan for when to release the payload after glamsterdam. There are two options: 1) release right after seeing the commitment -> similar to today 2) wait for attestation deadline / count attestations, observe equivocations, etc -> basically delay payload publishing. Where this matters is tx inclusion time. E.g. if there are 2s between comitting to the bid and releasing the payload, then this directly adds to the avg inclusion time of [7s of today](https://txdelay.pics/). the main consideration is same-slot-unbundling risk, however, ePBS only improves the situation there: builders *can* delay their release but if they are happy with things today, they *should not*.
